images.title: LINZ QGIS AIMS address feature-editing form, documented in 2024
images.dateDisplay: Original image available in LINZ repository by 18 April 2024; screenshot capture date unknown
images.caption: A real LINZ QGIS AIMS plugin feature-editing form, showing address, road centreline and addressable-object fields in source documentation available by April 2024.
images.altText: LINZ QGIS AIMS feature edit window with address number, unit, road name, road centreline and addressable-object data fields.
images.context: Official LINZ QGIS AIMS plugin project screen used to document the editing of Address Information Management System data. This is a GIS workflow interface, not evidence of the original system launch date. The image was recorded in the repository before 2025; its exact capture date is not established.

images.title: IntraMaps search interface in LINZ QGIS AIMS documentation
images.dateDisplay: Original image available in LINZ repository by 18 April 2024; screenshot capture date unknown
images.caption: The IntraMaps Search interface documented with the LINZ QGIS AIMS plugin, offering address, meshblock, road, title and appellation search tabs.
images.altText: IntraMaps Search window with tabs for address, meshblock, road, appellation, title and title-owner searches.
